username.label: Username
username.description: Your username for this Open Subsonic server

password.label: Password
password.description: The password associated with the username

baseURL.label: Base URL
baseURL.description: Base URL for the server, e.g. https://subsonic.mydomain.tld

path.label: Server Path
path.description: Path to append to the base URL for the Subsonic server, this is likely empty unless you are path routing on a proxy

enable_podcasts.label: Enable Podcasts
enable_podcasts.description: Should the provider query for podcasts as well as music?

enable_radios.label: Enable Internet Radio
enable_radios.description: Should the provider query for internet radio stations as well as music?

sync_interval_artists.label: Artist sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_artists.description: How often to sync artists from this server, in hours. Leave blank for the default (12h). Minimum 1 hour.

sync_interval_albums.label: Album sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_albums.description: How often to sync albums from this server, in hours. Leave blank for the default (12h). Minimum 1 hour.

sync_interval_tracks.label: Track sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_tracks.description: How often to sync tracks from this server, in hours. Leave blank for the default (12h). Minimum 1 hour.

sync_interval_playlists.label: Playlist sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_playlists.description: How often to sync playlists from this server, in hours. Leave blank for the default (12h). Minimum 1 hour.

sync_interval_podcasts.label: Podcast sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_podcasts.description: How often to sync podcasts from this server, in hours. Leave blank for the default (12h). Minimum 1 hour.

sync_interval_radios.label: Internet radio sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_radios.description: How often to sync internet radio stations from this server, in hours. Leave blank for the default (12h). Minimum 1 hour. Lower this to keep a live-station list fresh.

override_transcode_offest.label: Force Player Provider Seek
override_transcode_offest.description: Some Subsonic implementations advertise that they support seeking when they do not always. If seeking does not work for you, enable this.

recommend_favorites.label: Recommend Favorites
recommend_favorites.description: Should favorited (starred) items be included as recommendations.

recommend_new.label: Recommend New Albums
recommend_new.description: Should new albums be included as recommendations.

recommend_played.label: Recommend Most Played
recommend_played.description: Should most played albums be included as recommendations.

recommendation_count.label: Recommendation Limit
recommendation_count.description: How many recommendations from each enabled type should be included.

request_raw_file.label: No Transcoding For Streams
request_raw_file.description: Request that the server provide the original source file without applying any transcoding rules.

pagination_size.label: Number of items included per server request.
pagination_size.description: When enumerating items from the server, how many should be in each request. Smaller will require more requests but is better for low bandwidth connections. The Open Subsonic spec says the max value for this is 500 items.

manifest.description: Stream music from your OpenSubsonic compatible server — your own cloud jukebox.
